account.description: One account: its account_hash (from list_accounts), the last 3 or more digits of its number (135 or ...135), its store ref (A1) or its nickname; every account when left out.

from.description: The first New York date of entry, YYYY-MM-DD; 59 days before to when left out, and at most 363 days before to: one call asks for 364 days at most, to included. Schwab may serve fewer.

to.description: The last New York date of entry, YYYY-MM-DD, included; today when left out, or when later than today.

statuses.description: Only orders in these of Schwab's statuses, such as WORKING or FILLED (schwab://reference/order-statuses lists them); every status when left out.

open.description: Only open orders, which may still fill or change: every status but FILLED, CANCELED, REJECTED, EXPIRED and REPLACED.

symbol.description: One symbol, in any case: the orders with a leg of it, or of an option on it.

detail.description: compact (the default) or full, which adds each order's fills, venue and origin, and each leg's instrument.

limit.description: The most orders of a page, 1 to 200; 50 when left out. A page also stops at about 20,000 bytes.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with the same other arguments.
